channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Franz Wagner | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Franz Wagner from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Matas Buzelis on Deni Avdija, Franz Wagner
item.description:
Matas Buzelis:

“To be honest, whoI really want to work with is Deni Avdija. I've been talking with him. It's just, I feel like I was shooting too many threes. I need to get to the rim more. I want to know like how he lowers his shoulder, how he attacks. I seen him in Vegas. We're supposed to work out this weekend. He's somebody, Franz Wagner, probably him, KD, of course. That's who everybody needs to work out with, but I think right now Deni Avdija.”

Matas Buzelis on Deni Avdija, Franz Wagner, Jul 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Jamahl Mosley on Franz Wagner/Paolo Banchero:

“It's a big time opportunity for all of our guys, to experience this level of competition... there's levels to it ... it's very good for this group to experience this in this environment.”

Jamahl Mosley on Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero, Apr 20, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Monty Williams on Bol Bol, Wendell Carter, Franz Wagner
item.description:
Suns coachMonty Williams:

“Bol [Bol] is just…different. [Wendell] Carter is underrated. I liked him in Chicago. He’s better than advertised. [Franz] Wagner is one of the best young players in the league. He can flat-out go.”

Monty Williams on Bol Bol, Wendell Carter, Franz Wagner, Nov 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @khobi_price.
